senses.usageNote: In British English, 'be made redundant' means to lose your job because it is no longer needed.

senses.definition: happening at exactly the same time

examples.text: The concert had simultaneous translation into three languages.

translations.zh: 这场音乐会提供三种语言的同声传译。

senses.definition: to end something, or to stop at a certain place

examples.text: This train terminates at the next station.

translations.zh: 本次列车在下一站终止运行。

senses.definition: to be strong enough not to be damaged by something

examples.text: The house is built to withstand strong winds.

translations.zh: 这座房子建得能抵御强风。

senses.definition: the arrival or start of something important

examples.text: The advent of the internet changed how people study.

translations.zh: 互联网的出现改变了人们的学习方式。

senses.usageNote: Usually 'the advent of something'.

senses.definition: increasing by one addition after another

examples.text: Small daily savings have a cumulative effect over time.

translations.zh: 每天少量储蓄，日积月累效果显著。

senses.definition: to make something worse in quality; to break down slowly

examples.text: Plastic takes hundreds of years to degrade.

translations.zh: 塑料需要几百年才能降解。

senses.definition: to stop something happening easily or make it slower

examples.text: Heavy snow hampered the rescue team.

translations.zh: 大雪妨碍了救援队的行动。

senses.usageNote: As a noun, 'a hamper' is a basket for food, e.g. a picnic hamper.

senses.definition: based on possible situations rather than real ones

examples.text: Let's consider a hypothetical situation: what if school started at noon?

translations.zh: 我们来假设一种情况：如果中午才上学会怎样？

senses.definition: easily affected or harmed by something

examples.text: Young plants are susceptible to frost.

senses.usageNote: Always followed by 'to': 'susceptible to colds'.

senses.definition: a person who gets something good from a situation

examples.text: Local children are the main beneficiaries of the new park.

translations.zh: 当地儿童是新公园的主要受益者。

senses.definition: a lot of things lying around in an untidy way

examples.text: Clear the clutter off your desk before you start.

translations.zh: 开始前先把书桌上杂乱的东西清理掉。

senses.usageNote: Uncountable: say 'a lot of clutter', not 'clutters'.

senses.definition: respect and admiration for someone

examples.text: The teacher is held in high esteem by her students.

translations.zh: 这位老师深受学生敬重。

senses.usageNote: Common: 'hold someone in high esteem'; 'self-esteem' means how you value yourself.

senses.definition: very busy and full of activity

examples.text: The last week of term is always hectic.

translations.zh: 学期最后一周总是非常忙乱。

senses.definition: complete and total; clear and direct

translations.zh: 彻底的；完全的；直截了当的

examples.text: She was the outright winner of the competition.

translations.zh: 她是这次比赛无可争议的冠军。

senses.usageNote: As an adverb it is stressed /ˌaʊtˈraɪt/: 'He refused outright.'

senses.definition: able to recover quickly from difficulties or damage

translations.zh: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的

examples.text: Children are often more resilient than adults think.

translations.zh: 孩子们往往比大人想象的更有韧性。

senses.definition: to follow a rule, plan or belief closely

examples.text: All players must adhere to the rules of the game.

translations.zh: 所有选手都必须遵守比赛规则。

senses.usageNote: Always 'adhere to something'. The noun is 'adherence'.

senses.definition: happening often and so not unusual

examples.text: Mobile phones are now commonplace in every home.

translations.zh: 手机如今在每个家庭都很常见。

senses.definition: causing harm or damage

examples.text: Lack of sleep is detrimental to your health.

senses.usageNote: Always 'detrimental to something'.

senses.definition: to try hard to deal with a difficult problem

examples.text: Scientists are still grappling with this question.

translations.zh: 科学家们仍在努力解决这个问题。

senses.usageNote: Usually 'grapple with a problem/question'.

senses.definition: a feeling that makes you want to do something

examples.text: I had no inclination to go out in the rain.

translations.zh: 我一点也不想冒雨出门。

senses.definition: a short failure of attention or memory; also a period of time passing

examples.text: A brief lapse in concentration cost him the game.

translations.zh: 短暂的走神让他输掉了比赛。

senses.definition: the way someone earns the money they need to live

examples.text: Fishing is the main livelihood of people in the village.

translations.zh: 捕鱼是村里人的主要生计。

senses.definition: a person or thing that is annoying or causes problems

examples.text: The noisy traffic outside is a real nuisance.

translations.zh: 外面嘈杂的车流声真让人烦。

senses.definition: the state of being near something in space or time

examples.text: The hotel's main attraction is its proximity to the beach.

translations.zh: 这家酒店最吸引人的是它靠近海滩。

senses.usageNote: Common pattern: 'in close proximity to'.

senses.definition: having doubts that something is true or useful

examples.text: I was sceptical about the diet, but it worked.

translations.zh: 我起初对这种饮食法持怀疑态度，但它确实有效。

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'sceptical'; American English uses 'skeptical'. Use 'sceptical about/of'.

senses.definition: only on the surface, or not deep or thorough

examples.text: The car had only superficial scratches.

senses.definition: to show or announce something new to the public for the first time

examples.text: The company unveiled its new electric bike yesterday.

translations.zh: 该公司昨天发布了新款电动自行车。

senses.definition: having a lot of money and a comfortable life

examples.text: They grew up in an affluent part of the city.

translations.zh: 他们在城市的富人区长大。

senses.definition: to do something special to remember an important person or event

examples.text: A statue was built to commemorate the famous scientist.

translations.zh: 人们建了一座雕像来纪念这位著名科学家。

senses.definition: a big difference between things, often an unfair one

examples.text: There is a disparity between the two teams' scores.

senses.definition: a short part taken from a longer text, film or piece of music

examples.text: We read an excerpt from the novel in class.

translations.zh: 我们在课堂上读了这部小说的节选。

senses.definition: a typical feature of someone or something

examples.text: Careful research is the hallmark of a good report.

translations.zh: 严谨的研究是好报告的标志。

senses.definition: too important to be without

translations.zh: 必不可少的；不可或缺的

examples.text: A good dictionary is indispensable for language learners.

translations.zh: 对学语言的人来说，一本好词典是必不可少的。

senses.usageNote: Use 'indispensable to/for someone or something'.

senses.definition: to move something carefully, especially in a small space

examples.text: She manoeuvred the car into the narrow parking space.

translations.zh: 她把车小心地开进了狭窄的停车位。

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'manoeuvre'; American English uses 'maneuver'.

senses.definition: to notice or understand something that is not obvious

examples.text: It was hard to discern the path in the fog.

translations.zh: 在雾中很难辨认出小路。

senses.definition: to start including more different types of things

examples.text: The café diversified its menu to include vegan dishes.

translations.zh: 这家咖啡馆丰富了菜单，加入了纯素菜品。

senses.definition: large in amount, size or weight

examples.text: They had to pay a hefty fee for the late return.

translations.zh: 他们因逾期归还被罚了一大笔钱。

senses.definition: a lack of desire to change or act; the tendency of objects to stay still or keep moving

examples.text: Inertia kept me on the sofa all afternoon.

translations.zh: 惰性让我整个下午都待在沙发上。

senses.definition: to try to help two sides who disagree to reach an agreement

examples.text: The head teacher mediated between the two groups of pupils.

translations.zh: 校长在两群学生之间进行了调解。

senses.definition: to not include something, either on purpose or by mistake

examples.text: You can omit the sugar if you prefer.

translations.zh: 如果你喜欢，可以不放糖。

senses.usageNote: Double the 't': 'omitted', 'omitting'.

senses.definition: to examine and repair or improve something completely

examples.text: The school is overhauling its timetable for next year.

translations.zh: 学校正在全面调整明年的课程表。

senses.usageNote: The noun is stressed on the first syllable: /ˈəʊvəhɔːl/.

senses.definition: very strong or powerful

examples.text: Music can be a potent way to bring people together.

translations.zh: 音乐可以是凝聚人心的有力方式。

senses.definition: to live in a particular place (formal)

examples.text: The family now resides in a small town near the coast.

translations.zh: 这家人现在住在海边附近的一个小镇上。

senses.definition: the period of time when someone holds an important job

examples.text: During her tenure as head teacher, the school grew quickly.

translations.zh: 她担任校长期间，学校发展迅速。

senses.definition: to use something for a practical purpose (formal)

examples.text: The school utilises solar panels to save energy.

translations.zh: 学校利用太阳能电池板来节约能源。

senses.usageNote: In everyday English, 'use' is usually better; 'utilise' sounds formal.

senses.definition: in an opposite way

examples.text: Some plants like shade; conversely, others need full sun.

translations.zh: 有些植物喜阴；相反，另一些则需要充足的阳光。

senses.definition: to be a sign of something or represent it

examples.text: On this map, blue lines denote rivers.

translations.zh: 在这张地图上，蓝线代表河流。

senses.definition: understanding a situation only after it has happened

examples.text: In hindsight, we should have left earlier.

translations.zh: 事后看来，我们应该早点出发。

senses.usageNote: Usually 'in hindsight' or 'with hindsight'.

senses.definition: very clever and original

examples.text: She came up with an ingenious way to carry the eggs.

translations.zh: 她想出了一个巧妙的运鸡蛋的办法。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse with 'ingenuous' (innocent and trusting).

senses.definition: very careful, with great attention to detail

examples.text: He kept meticulous records of every review.

translations.zh: 他一丝不苟地记录了每一次复习。

senses.definition: very obvious, in a way that seems not to care

examples.text: Copying your friend's homework is a blatant form of cheating.

translations.zh: 抄朋友的作业是一种明目张胆的作弊。

senses.definition: working hard and carefully

examples.text: A diligent student reviews her notes every evening.

translations.zh: 勤奋的学生每天晚上都复习笔记。

senses.definition: extremely beautiful and delicate

examples.text: She wore an exquisite silk scarf.

translations.zh: 她戴着一条精美的丝巾。

senses.definition: kind and not causing unnecessary suffering

examples.text: The farm is known for its humane treatment of animals.

translations.zh: 这个农场以善待动物而闻名。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'humane' (kind) with 'human' (a person).

senses.definition: so small that it is not important

translations.zh: 微不足道的；可以忽略的

examples.text: The price difference between the two phones is negligible.

translations.zh: 这两款手机的价格差异微乎其微。

senses.definition: to be greater or more important than something else

examples.text: The benefits of the plan outweigh the costs.

translations.zh: 这个计划的好处大于成本。

senses.definition: a very difficult or unpleasant situation

examples.text: The film shows the plight of endangered pandas.

translations.zh: 这部电影展现了濒危大熊猫的困境。

senses.definition: a person allowed to act for someone else; or something used to represent something else

examples.text: Test scores are only a rough proxy for real learning.

translations.zh: 考试分数只是衡量真实学习情况的一个粗略指标。

senses.definition: to copy something exactly, or repeat an experiment to get the same result

examples.text: Other scientists could not replicate the results.

translations.zh: 其他科学家无法重复出这些结果。

senses.definition: to create conditions that are like real ones, often for training or testing

examples.text: The computer program simulates flying a plane.

translations.zh: 这个电脑程序模拟驾驶飞机。

senses.definition: not certain or definite, and may change

translations.zh: 暂定的；试探性的；犹豫的

examples.text: We made tentative plans to meet next week.

translations.zh: 我们初步计划下周见面。

senses.definition: agreed by everyone

translations.zh: 一致同意的；全体一致的

examples.text: The decision to paint the room blue was unanimous.

translations.zh: 把房间刷成蓝色的决定是全体一致通过的。

senses.definition: able to do many different things or be used in many ways

examples.text: Eggs are one of the most versatile foods in the kitchen.

translations.zh: 鸡蛋是厨房里用途最广的食材之一。

senses.usageNote: British pronunciation ends /-taɪl/; American often ends /-tl/.

senses.definition: very tired, especially after a long effort

examples.text: The weary hikers finally reached the hut.

translations.zh: 疲惫的徒步者们终于到达了小屋。

senses.usageNote: 'Weary of' means tired of or bored with: 'weary of waiting'.

senses.definition: to move towards the same point and meet

examples.text: Three rivers converge near the town.

translations.zh: 三条河在小镇附近交汇。

senses.usageNote: The opposite is 'diverge'.

senses.definition: to give out things to people

examples.text: The machine dispenses hot drinks and snacks.

translations.zh: 这台机器出售热饮和零食。

senses.usageNote: 'Dispense with' means to stop using something because it is not needed.

senses.definition: able to speak or write in a clear, powerful way

translations.zh: 雄辩的；有说服力的；善于表达的

examples.text: She gave an eloquent speech about protecting the ocean.

translations.zh: 她发表了一篇关于保护海洋的动人演讲。

senses.definition: to slow down or block progress

examples.text: Fallen trees impeded our progress along the path.

translations.zh: 倒下的树阻碍了我们沿小路前进。

senses.definition: to have a close connection where one thing changes with another

examples.text: Hours of sleep often correlate with how well students concentrate.

translations.zh: 睡眠时长往往与学生的专注程度相关。

senses.usageNote: Correlation is not the same as cause: two things can correlate without one causing the other.

senses.definition: to get information or a reaction from someone

examples.text: The teacher's question elicited some interesting answers.

translations.zh: 老师的问题引出了一些有趣的回答。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse with 'illicit' (not allowed by law), which sounds similar.

senses.definition: to make a bad situation worse

examples.text: Skipping reviews exacerbates the backlog.

senses.definition: dealing with the whole of something, not just its parts

examples.text: The school takes a holistic approach to education.

translations.zh: 学校采取全面的教育方式。

senses.definition: very poor

examples.text: The charity builds schools in impoverished areas.

translations.zh: 这家慈善机构在贫困地区建学校。

senses.definition: worried that something bad may happen

examples.text: She felt apprehensive before her first piano concert.

translations.zh: 第一次钢琴演奏会前她感到忐忑不安。

senses.usageNote: Use 'apprehensive about something'.

senses.definition: to reach a conclusion by thinking about the facts you know

examples.text: From the footprints, she deduced that a fox had visited.

translations.zh: 她根据脚印推断出有狐狸来过。

senses.usageNote: The noun is 'deduction'.

senses.definition: full of problems or worry

translations.zh: 充满（问题或危险）的；忧虑的

examples.text: The journey was fraught with difficulties.

senses.usageNote: Usually 'fraught with something' (problems, danger, difficulty).

senses.definition: not supporting one side more than another; fair

examples.text: The judges must remain impartial.

senses.definition: present but hidden and not yet developed or noticed

examples.text: The coach saw latent talent in the quiet boy.

translations.zh: 教练在那个安静的男孩身上看到了潜在的天赋。

senses.definition: a belief that is wrong because it is based on poor understanding

examples.text: It is a common misconception that bats are blind.

translations.zh: 认为蝙蝠是瞎子是一种常见的误解。

senses.definition: failure to take proper care of something you are responsible for

examples.text: The flood in the kitchen was caused by negligence.

translations.zh: 厨房进水是由于疏忽造成的。

senses.definition: a very difficult and unpleasant experience

examples.text: Waiting eight hours at the airport was a real ordeal.

translations.zh: 在机场等了八个小时真是一场折磨。

senses.definition: not as important as the main part; at the edge

examples.text: Let's not waste time on peripheral issues.

translations.zh: 我们别在次要问题上浪费时间。

senses.definition: arranged for now but likely to change later

examples.text: The match date is provisional until the weather improves.

translations.zh: 天气好转之前，比赛日期都是暂定的。

senses.definition: connected with amounts that can be measured

examples.text: We need quantitative data, such as test scores.

translations.zh: 我们需要定量数据，比如考试分数。

senses.definition: continuing strongly without stopping or getting weaker

examples.text: The relentless rain lasted for three days.

senses.definition: remaining after most of something has gone

examples.text: Wash the fruit to remove any residual dirt.

translations.zh: 把水果洗一下，去掉残留的泥土。

senses.definition: an attitude of doubting that something is true or useful

examples.text: The new idea was met with scepticism at first.

translations.zh: 这个新想法起初遭到了怀疑。

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'scepticism'; American English uses 'skepticism'.

senses.definition: to fall suddenly in value or amount; or to sit or fall heavily

examples.text: Ice cream sales slumped during the rainy summer.

translations.zh: 多雨的夏天冰淇淋销量暴跌。

senses.definition: the curved path of an object moving through the air; also the way something develops

examples.text: The ball followed a high trajectory over the wall.

translations.zh: 球划出一道高高的弧线飞过了墙。

senses.definition: a state of great confusion or worry

examples.text: The office was in turmoil after the computers crashed.

translations.zh: 电脑死机后，办公室一片混乱。

senses.definition: to support a rule or principle and make sure it continues

examples.text: Referees must uphold the rules of the game.

translations.zh: 裁判必须维护比赛规则。

senses.definition: to prove that something is true or correct, or make it officially acceptable

examples.text: More tests are needed to validate the results.

translations.zh: 需要更多的测试来证实这些结果。

senses.definition: careful because you think there may be danger or problems

examples.text: Be wary of emails asking for your password.

translations.zh: 要提防那些索要密码的电子邮件。

senses.usageNote: Use 'wary of something/someone'. Do not confuse with 'weary' (tired).

senses.definition: to end with an important event or result

examples.text: The year's hard work culminated in a great concert.

translations.zh: 一年的努力最终成就了一场精彩的音乐会。

senses.usageNote: Use 'culminate in something'.

senses.definition: famous and respected in a particular area

examples.text: An eminent scientist visited our school.

translations.zh: 一位杰出的科学家访问了我们学校。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'eminent' (famous) with 'imminent' (about to happen).

senses.definition: changing often in a way that is not regular or expected

examples.text: The old clock keeps erratic time.

senses.definition: having a limit or an end

examples.text: The Earth has a finite supply of oil.

translations.zh: 地球的石油储量是有限的。

senses.usageNote: The opposite is 'infinite' /ˈɪnfɪnət/ — note the different pronunciation.

senses.definition: depending on something else happening

examples.text: Our picnic is contingent on the weather.

translations.zh: 我们的野餐要视天气而定。

senses.usageNote: Always 'contingent on/upon something'.

senses.definition: completely without something

examples.text: The desert is almost devoid of plants.

senses.usageNote: Always 'devoid of something'.

senses.definition: lasting only a very short time

examples.text: We caught a fleeting glimpse of a deer in the woods.

translations.zh: 我们在树林里瞥见了一只鹿。

senses.definition: the beginning or origin of something

examples.text: The genesis of the idea was a conversation over lunch.

translations.zh: 这个想法起源于午餐时的一次聊天。

senses.definition: very confused and not sure what to do

examples.text: The new student looked bewildered in the huge school.

translations.zh: 这位新同学在偌大的学校里显得不知所措。

senses.definition: the state of fitting or working together well as a whole

examples.text: Team games build cohesion in a class.

translations.zh: 团队游戏能增强班级凝聚力。

senses.definition: not active now, but able to become active later

examples.text: The volcano has been dormant for centuries.

translations.zh: 这座火山已经休眠了几个世纪。

senses.definition: having no chance of success; pointless

examples.text: It was futile to try to catch the bus now.

translations.zh: 现在想赶上那班车已是徒劳。

senses.definition: the arrival of a large number of people or things

examples.text: The town sees an influx of tourists every summer.

translations.zh: 每年夏天都有大批游客涌入这个小镇。

senses.usageNote: Use 'an influx of something/someone'.

senses.definition: a very large number of people or things

examples.text: The app offers a multitude of ways to practise English.

translations.zh: 这个应用提供了多种练习英语的方法。

senses.definition: a very large number of something

examples.text: The coral reef is home to a myriad of colourful fish.

translations.zh: 珊瑚礁是无数色彩斑斓的鱼儿的家园。

senses.definition: no longer used because something newer has replaced it

examples.text: Smartphones have made many old gadgets obsolete.

translations.zh: 智能手机使许多旧的小装置被淘汰了。

senses.definition: a person who supports an idea or plan

examples.text: He is a strong proponent of outdoor learning.

translations.zh: 他是户外学习的坚定支持者。

senses.definition: the ability to remember something, or a memory

examples.text: I have no recollection of meeting her before.

senses.definition: to try hard to deal with a difficult problem

examples.text: I spent an hour wrestling with this maths problem.

translations.zh: 我花了一个小时苦苦思索这道数学题。

senses.usageNote: The 't' is silent. Usually 'wrestle with a problem/decision'.

senses.definition: very easy to see or notice

examples.text: His bright orange hat was conspicuous in the crowd.

translations.zh: 他那顶鲜橙色的帽子在人群中十分显眼。

senses.usageNote: The phrase 'conspicuous by its absence' means you notice something because it is missing.

senses.definition: to reduce the amount of something so there is not much left

examples.text: Long walks in the heat deplete your energy.

translations.zh: 在炎热天气下长时间行走会耗尽你的体力。

senses.definition: to become weaker or less certain; to hesitate

examples.text: Her voice faltered when she forgot her lines.

translations.zh: 她忘词时声音变得结结巴巴。

senses.definition: introducing new and important ideas or methods

examples.text: Her groundbreaking research helped many patients.

translations.zh: 她开创性的研究帮助了许多病人。

senses.definition: existing from birth, not learned

examples.text: She has an innate talent for music.

senses.definition: having mixed feelings about something

translations.zh: 矛盾的；（情感）摇摆不定的

examples.text: I feel ambivalent about moving to a new school.

translations.zh: 对于转去新学校，我心情很矛盾。

senses.definition: to agree with someone or something

examples.text: The judges concurred that her painting was the best.

translations.zh: 评委们一致认为她的画是最好的。

senses.usageNote: Formal. Use 'concur with someone/something'.

senses.definition: to go in different directions; to become different

examples.text: The path diverges into two smaller trails.

translations.zh: 小路分成了两条更窄的小径。

senses.usageNote: The opposite is 'converge'.

senses.definition: to cover something to stop heat, sound or electricity passing through it

examples.text: We insulated the attic to keep the house warm.

translations.zh: 我们给阁楼做了隔热处理以保持房屋温暖。

senses.definition: remembering something and considering it carefully

examples.text: Please be mindful of other people when using your phone.

translations.zh: 使用手机时请顾及他人。

senses.usageNote: The usual pattern is 'mindful of something'.

senses.definition: a happy but slightly sad feeling when you think about the past

examples.text: Old photos filled Grandad with nostalgia.

translations.zh: 老照片让爷爷满怀怀旧之情。

senses.definition: to block a path or stop something from happening easily

examples.text: A fallen tree obstructed the path.

translations.zh: 一棵倒下的树挡住了小路。

senses.definition: something that has been left out, or the act of leaving it out

examples.text: The omission of her name from the list was a mistake.

translations.zh: 名单上漏掉她的名字是个失误。

senses.definition: more important than anything else

examples.text: The safety of the children is paramount.

translations.zh: 孩子们的安全是最重要的。

senses.usageNote: Usually after a verb such as 'be' or 'become', and rarely before a noun.

senses.definition: to think carefully about something for a long time

examples.text: She pondered the question before answering.

translations.zh: 她思考了一下这个问题才回答。

senses.definition: connected with how good something is, rather than how much of it there is

examples.text: The study used qualitative interviews with teachers.

translations.zh: 这项研究采用了对教师的定性访谈。

senses.definition: less important, or having a lower position than someone else

examples.text: A subordinate clause cannot stand alone as a sentence.

translations.zh: 从句不能单独构成一个句子。

senses.definition: the quality of having two halves that are exactly the same

examples.text: Butterflies show perfect symmetry in their wings.

translations.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀呈现完美的对称。

senses.definition: greatest possible

examples.text: This matter is of the utmost importance.

senses.usageNote: Fixed phrases: 'of the utmost importance', 'do your utmost'.

senses.definition: providing the right conditions for something to happen

examples.text: A quiet room is conducive to good study.

translations.zh: 安静的房间有助于好好学习。

senses.usageNote: Always 'conducive to something'.

senses.definition: to be a typical example of something

examples.text: This building exemplifies modern design.

translations.zh: 这座建筑是现代设计的典范。

senses.definition: stopping and starting again over a period of time

examples.text: We had intermittent rain throughout the afternoon.

translations.zh: 整个下午断断续续地下着雨。

senses.definition: to take in and fully understand information; to become part of a group

examples.text: It takes time to assimilate so many new facts.

translations.zh: 吸收这么多新知识需要时间。

senses.definition: to bring people together for a formal meeting

examples.text: The head teacher convened a meeting of all staff.

translations.zh: 校长召集了全体教职工开会。

senses.definition: to become gradually smaller in number or amount

examples.text: The number of bees has been dwindling for years.

translations.zh: 蜜蜂的数量多年来一直在减少。

senses.definition: a small increase in amount

examples.text: The temperature rose in small increments.

senses.definition: a person who is new to an activity and has little experience

examples.text: This ski slope is perfect for novices.

translations.zh: 这条滑雪道非常适合初学者。

senses.definition: a very small difference in meaning, feeling or sound

examples.text: Synonyms rarely match in every nuance.

translations.zh: 同义词很少在每个细微之处都吻合。

senses.definition: most common, noticeable or powerful

examples.text: Green is the predominant colour in the painting.

translations.zh: 绿色是这幅画的主色调。

senses.definition: the area near or around a place

examples.text: There are three parks in the vicinity of our school.

translations.zh: 我们学校附近有三个公园。

senses.usageNote: Usually in the phrase 'in the vicinity (of)'.

senses.definition: too satisfied with yourself, so you stop trying

examples.text: After winning twice, the team became complacent and lost.

translations.zh: 赢了两场后，球队变得自满，结果输了。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse with 'complaisant' (willing to please others), which is rare.

senses.definition: a clever trick used to attract attention, often without real value

examples.text: The free toy is just a gimmick to sell more cereal.

translations.zh: 免费玩具只是为了多卖麦片的噱头。

senses.definition: to pay attention to advice or a warning

examples.text: Heed the warning signs on the mountain path.

senses.usageNote: Formal. Common as 'take heed of' or 'pay no heed to'.

senses.definition: a strong feeling of not liking something

examples.text: My brother has an aversion to green vegetables.

translations.zh: 我弟弟很讨厌绿色蔬菜。

senses.usageNote: Use 'an aversion to something'.

senses.definition: to do something different from what is usual or planned

examples.text: The bus had to deviate from its normal route.

translations.zh: 公交车不得不偏离正常路线。

senses.usageNote: Use 'deviate from something'.

senses.definition: to mention something in an indirect way

examples.text: She alluded to a surprise but refused to say more.

translations.zh: 她暗示有个惊喜，但不肯多说。

senses.usageNote: Always 'allude to something'. Don't confuse with 'elude' (to escape).

senses.definition: including everything possible; very thorough

examples.text: This is not an exhaustive list, just a few examples.

translations.zh: 这并非详尽的清单，只是几个例子。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse with 'exhausting' (making you very tired).

senses.definition: the main idea of something

examples.text: I didn't understand every word, but I got the gist.

translations.zh: 我没有听懂每个词，但明白了大意。

senses.usageNote: Common: 'get the gist', 'the gist of the story'.

senses.definition: until now or until a particular time

examples.text: The scientists found a hitherto unknown species of frog.

translations.zh: 科学家发现了一种迄今未知的青蛙物种。

senses.usageNote: Very formal; in everyday English say 'until now' or 'so far'.

senses.definition: to express sadness or disappointment about something

examples.text: Many older residents lament the loss of the old market.

translations.zh: 许多年长的居民为老市场的消失而惋惜。

senses.definition: to copy the way someone or something looks, sounds or behaves

examples.text: Parrots can mimic human voices.

senses.usageNote: Add 'k' before '-ed' and '-ing': 'mimicked', 'mimicking'.

senses.definition: ordinary and not interesting

examples.text: Robots could do many mundane tasks in the office.

translations.zh: 机器人可以完成办公室里许多单调乏味的工作。

senses.definition: late, or not done or paid by the expected time

translations.zh: 过期的；迟到的；早该发生的

examples.text: My library books are two days overdue.

translations.zh: 我借的图书馆的书已经过期两天了。

senses.usageNote: 'Long overdue' means something should have happened much earlier.

senses.definition: continuing for ever or happening again and again

examples.text: The house was in a perpetual state of mess.

senses.definition: producing a large number of works or results

examples.text: She is a prolific writer who publishes three books a year.

translations.zh: 她是一位多产的作家，每年出版三本书。

senses.definition: to push or move something forward

examples.text: The boat is propelled by a small electric motor.

translations.zh: 这条船由一台小型电动机推动。

senses.usageNote: Double the 'l': 'propelled', 'propelling'.

senses.definition: to happen again, or happen many times

examples.text: Friendship is a recurring theme in her stories.

translations.zh: 友谊是她故事中反复出现的主题。

senses.usageNote: Double the 'r' before '-ed' and '-ing': 'recurred', 'recurring'.

senses.definition: an effect of an action or event, often a bad one that comes later

examples.text: The decision could have serious repercussions for local shops.

translations.zh: 这个决定可能会给当地商店带来严重后果。

senses.usageNote: Usually used in the plural: 'repercussions'.

senses.definition: seeming to be everywhere at once

examples.text: Smartphones are now ubiquitous.

translations.zh: 智能手机现在无处不在。

senses.definition: to give support or a strong basis to an idea or system

examples.text: Good research underpins every chapter of the book.

translations.zh: 扎实的研究支撑着这本书的每一章。

senses.definition: to make something larger or better by adding to it

examples.text: She augments her pocket money by walking the neighbour's dog.

translations.zh: 她靠帮邻居遛狗来增加零花钱。

senses.definition: to try to be like someone you admire

examples.text: Many young players try to emulate their football heroes.

translations.zh: 许多年轻球员努力效仿自己的足球偶像。

senses.definition: to lose something because you have broken a rule

examples.text: The team forfeited the match because they arrived late.

translations.zh: 该队因迟到而被判弃权输掉比赛。

senses.definition: to make something happen sooner

examples.text: Warm weather hastened the melting of the snow.

translations.zh: 温暖的天气加快了积雪融化。

senses.usageNote: The 't' is silent. 'I hasten to add' means 'I want to say quickly'.

senses.definition: working hard and carefully to do things well

examples.text: He is a conscientious student who always checks his work.

translations.zh: 他是个认真的学生，总会检查自己的作业。

senses.usageNote: Spelling tip: 'science' is inside 'conscientious'.

senses.definition: to work out the meaning of something difficult to read or understand

examples.text: I couldn't decipher his messy handwriting.

translations.zh: 我辨认不出他潦草的字迹。

senses.definition: making you feel very happy and excited

translations.zh: 令人兴奋的；使人高兴的

examples.text: Riding the roller coaster was exhilarating.

translations.zh: 坐过山车真是太刺激了。

senses.definition: an idea that many people believe but that is false

examples.text: It is a fallacy that goldfish only remember things for three seconds.

translations.zh: 金鱼只有三秒记忆是一种谬传。

senses.definition: to collect information slowly, in small amounts

examples.text: We gleaned some useful tips from the guidebook.

translations.zh: 我们从旅游指南中收集了一些有用的小贴士。

senses.definition: to break a law or rule; to limit someone's rights

examples.text: Copying the song without permission infringes copyright.

translations.zh: 未经许可复制这首歌侵犯了版权。

senses.definition: to find out whether something is true

examples.text: The doctor tried to ascertain the cause of the rash.

translations.zh: 医生试图查明皮疹的原因。

senses.definition: a person or thing that is mysterious and hard to understand

examples.text: How the cat got onto the roof remains an enigma.

translations.zh: 猫是怎么上到屋顶的仍然是个谜。

senses.definition: loyalty; how exactly something copies the original

examples.text: The film shows great fidelity to the original book.

translations.zh: 这部电影非常忠实于原著。

senses.definition: having a good reason and therefore acceptable

translations.zh: 有理由的；合理的；情有可原的

examples.text: Her anger was justifiable after waiting two hours.

translations.zh: 等了两个小时后，她生气是情有可原的。

senses.definition: present or felt everywhere

examples.text: The influence of social media is pervasive among teenagers.

translations.zh: 社交媒体对青少年的影响无处不在。

senses.definition: to fall very quickly and suddenly

examples.text: Temperatures plummeted as soon as the sun went down.

translations.zh: 太阳一落山，气温就骤降。

senses.usageNote: Only one 't' in the past form: 'plummeted', 'plummeting'.

senses.definition: something produced while making something else; an extra result

examples.text: Sawdust is a by-product of making furniture.
examples.cloze: Sawdust is a {{by-product}} of making furniture.

translations.zh: 锯末是制作家具的副产品。

senses.definition: to reduce or limit something, often by cutting it short

examples.text: The match was curtailed because of heavy rain.

translations.zh: 比赛因大雨而提前结束。

senses.definition: fair and reasonable, treating everyone equally

examples.text: We need an equitable way to share the jobs.

translations.zh: 我们需要一个公平的分工办法。

senses.definition: perfect, with no mistakes

examples.text: Her manners are always impeccable.

translations.zh: 她的举止总是无可挑剔。

senses.definition: to make something impossible; to prevent it in advance

examples.text: Working offline does not preclude syncing later.

translations.zh: 离线使用并不排除以后同步的可能。

senses.definition: needing a lot of effort and energy

examples.text: The climb to the top was long and arduous.

translations.zh: 登顶的路程漫长而艰辛。

senses.definition: to give money to a school or organisation; to be born with a quality

examples.text: She is endowed with a great sense of humour.

senses.usageNote: Often passive: 'be endowed with a quality'.

senses.definition: not serious or sensible; silly

translations.zh: 轻浮的；琐碎的；不重要的

examples.text: Don't waste your money on frivolous things.

translations.zh: 别把钱浪费在无聊的东西上。

senses.definition: the way someone or something appears, often hiding the truth

examples.text: The old game has returned in a new guise.

translations.zh: 这款老游戏以新面貌回归了。

senses.usageNote: Common: 'in the guise of', 'under the guise of'.

senses.definition: a family relationship, or a feeling of being close to someone who is similar to you

examples.text: The two artists felt a strong kinship with each other.

translations.zh: 两位艺术家彼此之间有一种强烈的亲切感。

senses.definition: not aware of something happening around you

examples.text: He was reading, oblivious to the noise around him.

translations.zh: 他在看书，对周围的噪音浑然不觉。

senses.usageNote: Use 'oblivious to' or 'oblivious of' something.

senses.definition: a sudden strong expression of a feeling

examples.text: His joke caused an outburst of laughter.

translations.zh: 他的笑话引起了一阵哄堂大笑。

senses.definition: to find or describe something exactly

examples.text: The mechanic pinpointed the cause of the noise.

translations.zh: 技师准确找到了噪音的原因。

senses.definition: not safe or steady, and likely to fall or get worse

examples.text: The vase was in a precarious position on the shelf edge.

translations.zh: 花瓶放在架子边上，摇摇欲坠。

senses.definition: to measure or express something as an amount

examples.text: It is hard to quantify the value of friendship.

senses.definition: given or done by each of two people or groups to the other

examples.text: The two schools have a reciprocal exchange programme.

translations.zh: 两所学校之间有互惠交换项目。

senses.definition: small in number or amount and spread over a wide area

examples.text: The mountain's plant life is sparse.

senses.definition: to be enough (formal)

examples.text: A short email will suffice.

translations.zh: 一封简短的邮件就够了。

senses.usageNote: 'Suffice it to say...' is a fixed phrase meaning 'I will only say...'.

senses.definition: boring and lasting too long

examples.text: Copying out the list by hand was tedious.

translations.zh: 手抄这份清单非常乏味。

senses.definition: with a lot of sudden change or confusion; also moving violently, like air or water

examples.text: The small boat struggled across the turbulent river.

translations.zh: 小船艰难地渡过了湍急的河流。

senses.definition: done by one side without the agreement of others

examples.text: The club made a unilateral decision to change the match date.

translations.zh: 俱乐部单方面决定更改比赛日期。

senses.definition: the way a child is cared for and taught how to behave

examples.text: She had a happy upbringing in a small village.

translations.zh: 她在一个小村庄里快乐地长大。

senses.definition: to choose not to use a rule or right, or not to charge a fee

examples.text: The museum waived the entry fee for school groups.

translations.zh: 博物馆免除了学校团体的门票费。

senses.usageNote: Do not confuse with 'wave', which is to move your hand.

senses.definition: to accept behaviour that is wrong, as if it were acceptable

examples.text: The school does not condone rudeness of any kind.

translations.zh: 学校不容忍任何形式的无礼行为。

senses.usageNote: Often negative: 'I don't condone it' means 'I don't think it is OK'.

senses.definition: to invent false information in order to trick people; to make something

examples.text: He fabricated a story about losing his homework.

translations.zh: 他编了个作业丢了的故事。

senses.definition: to cause a process or event to start

examples.text: The head teacher instigated a review of school lunches.

translations.zh: 校长发起了对学校午餐的审查。

senses.definition: kind and wanting to help others

examples.text: The benevolent old man gave books to the village school.

translations.zh: 那位仁慈的老人向乡村学校捐赠了图书。

senses.definition: a perfect example of a quality or type

examples.text: She is the epitome of patience.

senses.usageNote: Pronounced with four syllables: i-PIT-uh-mee.

senses.definition: firmly fixed and difficult to change

translations.zh: 根深蒂固的；（污垢）难以去除的

examples.text: The habit of saying thank you is ingrained in her.

translations.zh: 说谢谢的习惯已深深扎根于她心中。

senses.definition: not very good; only of average quality

examples.text: The film had a great cast but a mediocre story.

translations.zh: 这部电影演员阵容强大，但故事平庸。

senses.definition: a small part of something that remains

examples.text: The wall is a remnant of the old castle.

translations.zh: 这堵墙是古城堡的残存部分。

senses.definition: a big change that causes a lot of confusion or worry

examples.text: Moving house caused a lot of upheaval for the family.

translations.zh: 搬家给这家人带来了很大的折腾。

senses.definition: able to float; cheerful and confident

translations.zh: 有浮力的；轻松愉快的；上涨的

examples.text: Wood is buoyant, so it floats on water.

translations.zh: 木头有浮力，所以能漂在水面上。

senses.definition: to spread information or ideas widely

examples.text: The charity disseminates health advice to villages.

translations.zh: 这家慈善机构向各村庄传播健康知识。

senses.definition: having or showing very strong feelings

examples.text: She is a fervent supporter of animal rights.

translations.zh: 她是动物权益的热心支持者。

senses.definition: to examine something very carefully

examples.text: Every claim in the paper was scrutinised.

translations.zh: 论文中的每一项主张都受到了仔细审查。

senses.usageNote: American English spells it 'scrutinize'.

senses.definition: to find a way to avoid a rule or problem

examples.text: They circumvented the traffic jam by taking a side road.

translations.zh: 他们走小路绕开了交通堵塞。

senses.definition: to force someone to do something they do not want to do

examples.text: Nobody should be coerced into joining a club.

translations.zh: 不应强迫任何人加入俱乐部。

senses.usageNote: Pattern: 'coerce someone into (doing) something'.

senses.definition: to make something stronger, especially to protect it

examples.text: Breakfast cereals are often fortified with vitamins.

translations.zh: 早餐谷物通常添加了维生素。

senses.definition: very difficult and tiring

examples.text: After a gruelling race, the runners rested in the shade.

translations.zh: 经过一场艰苦的比赛，选手们在树荫下休息。

senses.usageNote: British spelling has double 'l'; American is 'grueling'.

senses.definition: very skilful at doing something

examples.text: He is adept at solving tricky maths puzzles.

translations.zh: 他擅长解决复杂的数学难题。

senses.usageNote: Use 'adept at (doing) something', not 'adept in'.

senses.definition: including many different styles or ideas

translations.zh: 兼收并蓄的；不拘一格的

examples.text: She has an eclectic taste in music, from jazz to folk.

translations.zh: 她的音乐品味很广泛，从爵士到民谣都喜欢。

senses.definition: made of parts that are all the same or similar

examples.text: Mix the paint until it is homogeneous.

senses.definition: the main idea or theme of a speech, event or plan

examples.text: She gave the keynote speech at the science conference.

translations.zh: 她在科学大会上做了主题演讲。

senses.definition: suggesting that something bad is going to happen

examples.text: Ominous dark clouds gathered over the beach.

translations.zh: 海滩上空聚集着不祥的乌云。

senses.definition: to make a situation or belief continue, especially a bad one

examples.text: Some old films perpetuate unfair ideas about girls.

translations.zh: 一些老电影延续了对女孩的不公平观念。

senses.definition: something that must exist or happen before something else is possible

examples.text: Basic maths is a prerequisite for this course.

translations.zh: 基础数学是修读这门课程的先决条件。

senses.usageNote: Usually 'a prerequisite for something'.

senses.definition: sensible and careful, especially about the future

examples.text: It would be prudent to save some of your pocket money.

translations.zh: 把一部分零花钱存起来是明智的。

senses.definition: growing or spreading in an uncontrolled way

examples.text: Weeds were rampant in the neglected garden.

translations.zh: 荒废的花园里杂草丛生。

senses.definition: to save something from being lost or damaged, especially in a bad situation

examples.text: We managed to salvage a few photos from the old computer.

translations.zh: 我们设法从旧电脑中抢救出了几张照片。

senses.definition: to change information so that it is not accurate or fair

examples.text: One very high score skewed the class average.

translations.zh: 一个极高的分数拉偏了全班的平均分。

senses.definition: very strict and difficult to satisfy

examples.text: The factory must meet stringent safety standards.

translations.zh: 工厂必须达到严格的安全标准。

senses.definition: lasting only for a short time

examples.text: The pain was transient and soon disappeared.

translations.zh: 疼痛很短暂，很快就消失了。

senses.definition: to join people or things together into one

examples.text: The school sports day unified pupils of all ages.

translations.zh: 学校运动会让各个年级的学生团结在一起。

senses.definition: the rate at which people start using something new

examples.text: The uptake of the new reading app has been very fast.

translations.zh: 这款新阅读应用的使用率增长得非常快。

senses.usageNote: 'Quick/slow on the uptake' means quick or slow to understand.

senses.definition: a sudden wish to do something, without a good reason

examples.text: On a whim, we took the train to the seaside.

translations.zh: 我们心血来潮，坐火车去了海边。

senses.definition: growing or developing quickly

examples.text: The town has a burgeoning music scene.

translations.zh: 这个小镇的音乐氛围正蓬勃发展。

senses.definition: friendly and polite

examples.text: The visitors received a cordial welcome.

translations.zh: 来访者受到热情的欢迎。

senses.definition: an extra feeling or idea that a word suggests

examples.text: 'Slim' has a positive connotation, but 'skinny' can sound negative.

translations.zh: “slim”带有正面含义，而“skinny”听起来可能带贬义。

senses.definition: known or understood by only a few people

examples.text: The book was full of esoteric facts about ancient coins.

translations.zh: 这本书满是关于古钱币的冷门知识。

senses.definition: most noticeable or most important

examples.text: Let me summarise the salient points.

senses.definition: clever at understanding situations and people quickly

examples.text: An astute reader will notice the clue in chapter two.

translations.zh: 敏锐的读者会注意到第二章里的线索。

senses.definition: not organised; done without a plan

examples.text: The books were stacked in a haphazard way.

senses.definition: a fault in the way a machine works

examples.text: A malfunction in the lift trapped us for ten minutes.

translations.zh: 电梯故障把我们困了十分钟。

senses.definition: the most successful point of something

examples.text: Winning the gold medal was the pinnacle of her career.

translations.zh: 夺得金牌是她职业生涯的巅峰。

senses.definition: to say something again to make it clearer or stronger

examples.text: The coach reiterated the importance of warming up.

translations.zh: 教练重申了热身的重要性。

senses.usageNote: Do not add 'again' after it: 'reiterate' already means to repeat.

senses.definition: clever at understanding situations and making good decisions

examples.text: Buying the shop early was a shrewd move.

translations.zh: 早早买下那家店是个精明之举。

senses.definition: to separate twisted threads, or to explain something complicated

examples.text: Detectives in the story slowly unravel the mystery.

translations.zh: 故事中的侦探们慢慢解开了谜团。

senses.usageNote: British English doubles the 'l': 'unravelled', 'unravelling'.

senses.definition: to lead someone politely to a place

examples.text: A guide ushered us into the main hall.

translations.zh: 一位向导把我们引进了主厅。

senses.usageNote: 'Usher in' means to mark the start of something: 'usher in a new era'.

senses.definition: used in informal, everyday conversation

examples.text: 'Gonna' is a colloquial way of saying 'going to'.

senses.definition: a division between two very different or opposite things

examples.text: There is a dichotomy between what he says and what he does.

senses.definition: impossible to change or undo

translations.zh: 不可改变的；无法挽回的

examples.text: Once you post the letter, your decision is irrevocable.

translations.zh: 信一旦寄出，你的决定就无法更改了。

senses.definition: careful not to spend much money

examples.text: My grandparents live a frugal but happy life.

translations.zh: 我的祖父母过着简朴但幸福的生活。

senses.definition: always wanting more and never satisfied

translations.zh: 贪得无厌的；无法满足的

examples.text: My brother has an insatiable appetite for books.

translations.zh: 我弟弟对书的渴求永无止境。

senses.definition: a small mistake in a rule that lets people avoid doing what the rule intends

examples.text: They found a loophole in the game's rules.

translations.zh: 他们发现了游戏规则中的一个漏洞。

senses.definition: directly related to the subject being discussed

examples.text: She asked some very pertinent questions.

translations.zh: 她提出了一些非常切中要害的问题。

senses.definition: making you feel sad or full of emotion

translations.zh: 令人伤感的；感人至深的

examples.text: The film ends with a poignant farewell between two friends.

translations.zh: 电影以两个朋友之间感人的告别结尾。

senses.usageNote: The 'g' is silent: /ˈpɔɪnjənt/.

senses.definition: skilled at doing something because of practice

examples.text: She became proficient in English after two years abroad.

translations.zh: 在国外两年后，她的英语变得很熟练。

senses.usageNote: Use 'proficient in' or 'proficient at' something.

senses.definition: a friendly relationship in which people understand each other well

examples.text: The new teacher quickly built a rapport with the class.

translations.zh: 新老师很快就和全班同学建立了融洽的关系。

senses.usageNote: The final 't' is silent. Common phrase: 'build/establish a rapport with'.

senses.definition: smooth and without any sudden changes or problems

examples.text: The app offers a seamless switch between phone and tablet.

translations.zh: 这款应用可以在手机和平板之间无缝切换。

senses.definition: not moving or developing, and often unpleasant

examples.text: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water.

senses.definition: to go beyond the usual limits of something

examples.text: Good music transcends language barriers.

translations.zh: 好的音乐能超越语言障碍。

senses.definition: not expected to happen

translations.zh: 意料之外的；未预见到的

examples.text: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the concert has been cancelled.

translations.zh: 由于不可预见的情况，音乐会已被取消。

senses.definition: having original ideas about how the future could be

examples.text: The visionary engineer designed a car that runs on sunlight.

translations.zh: 这位有远见的工程师设计了一辆靠阳光驱动的汽车。

senses.definition: to become gradually weaker or smaller

examples.text: Interest in the game waned after a few weeks.

translations.zh: 几周后，人们对这款游戏的兴趣减弱了。

senses.definition: sure that your beliefs are right and unwilling to consider others

examples.text: Try not to be dogmatic when others disagree with you.

translations.zh: 别人与你意见不同时，尽量不要固执己见。

senses.definition: having no skill at something

translations.zh: 无能的；不称职的；笨拙的

examples.text: I'm completely inept at drawing horses.

senses.definition: very clear and certain, with no doubt

examples.text: She gave a categorical promise that she would be on time.

senses.definition: saying clearly and honestly what you think

examples.text: She is forthright about what she likes and dislikes.

translations.zh: 她对自己的好恶直言不讳。

senses.definition: to plan and organise something carefully, often secretly

examples.text: The students orchestrated a surprise party for their teacher.

translations.zh: 学生们为老师精心策划了一场惊喜派对。

senses.definition: to state clearly that something must be done, especially in an agreement

examples.text: The rules stipulate that phones must be switched off.

translations.zh: 规则明确要求手机必须关机。

senses.definition: watching carefully for possible danger or problems

examples.text: Stay vigilant when crossing busy roads.

translations.zh: 过繁忙的马路时要保持警惕。

senses.definition: skill in using your hands or mind quickly

examples.text: Playing the piano requires great dexterity.

translations.zh: 弹钢琴需要非常灵巧的手指。

senses.definition: to shock or excite someone into taking action

examples.text: The news galvanised students into cleaning up the beach.

translations.zh: 这个消息激励学生们去清理海滩。

senses.usageNote: Pattern: 'galvanise someone into action'. American spelling: 'galvanize'.

senses.definition: to guess about the future or a larger group using the facts you have

examples.text: We can't extrapolate from just one small survey.

translations.zh: 我们不能仅凭一项小型调查就作出推断。

senses.definition: made of many different kinds of people or things

examples.text: Our class is a heterogeneous mix of abilities.

translations.zh: 我们班学生的能力参差不齐。

senses.usageNote: The opposite is 'homogeneous'.

senses.definition: too great to be dealt with successfully

translations.zh: 无法克服的；难以逾越的

examples.text: The problems seemed insurmountable at first.

translations.zh: 起初这些问题看起来无法克服。

senses.definition: to provide evidence that proves something

examples.text: He could not substantiate the allegation.

senses.definition: the quality of using few words or lasting a short time

examples.text: The speech was praised for its brevity and humour.

translations.zh: 这篇演讲因简洁幽默而受到称赞。

senses.definition: to put something at risk of being harmed or lost

examples.text: Missing the deadline could jeopardise the whole project.

translations.zh: 错过截止日期可能会危及整个项目。

senses.usageNote: Usually followed by a thing, not a person: 'jeopardise your chances / your health / the plan'.

senses.definition: to stop something from having any effect

examples.text: Eating lots of sweets can negate the benefits of exercise.

translations.zh: 吃大量糖果会抵消运动的好处。

senses.definition: done openly, not hidden

examples.text: There was no overt sign that he was nervous.

translations.zh: 没有明显迹象表明他很紧张。

senses.definition: a false reason given to hide the real reason for doing something

examples.text: He visited on the pretext of borrowing a book.

senses.usageNote: Common phrases: 'on/under the pretext of', 'a pretext for'.

senses.definition: a judgement about how something, especially an illness, will develop

examples.text: The vet said the prognosis for the dog was good.

translations.zh: 兽医说这只狗的预后良好。

senses.definition: to correct something that is wrong

examples.text: The shop quickly rectified the mistake on my bill.

translations.zh: 商店很快纠正了我账单上的错误。

senses.definition: a return of something that had become less popular or active

examples.text: There has been a resurgence of interest in board games.

translations.zh: 人们对桌游的兴趣再度兴起。

senses.definition: to ask someone for something such as help, money or opinions

examples.text: The school is soliciting ideas from parents.

translations.zh: 学校正在向家长征求意见。

senses.definition: to make a system simpler and more effective

examples.text: The new app streamlines the booking process.

translations.zh: 新应用程序简化了预订流程。

senses.definition: to want something very much, especially something hard to get

examples.text: After weeks of rain, we yearned for sunshine.

translations.zh: 下了几周雨后，我们渴望阳光。

senses.usageNote: Use 'yearn for something' or 'yearn to do something'.

senses.definition: great energy and enthusiasm for something

examples.text: She joined the recycling project with great zeal.

translations.zh: 她满腔热情地参加了回收项目。

senses.definition: to provide information that supports a statement or idea

examples.text: Other witnesses corroborated her story.

translations.zh: 其他目击者证实了她的说法。

senses.definition: to name things one by one on a list

examples.text: She enumerated the reasons for her decision.

translations.zh: 她一一列举了她作出这个决定的理由。

senses.definition: enjoying the company of other people; living in groups

examples.text: My gregarious sister makes friends everywhere she goes.

translations.zh: 我那爱交际的姐姐走到哪儿都能交到朋友。

senses.definition: to make a process happen more quickly

examples.text: Paying extra will expedite the delivery of your parcel.

translations.zh: 多付点钱可以加快包裹的配送。

senses.definition: to give an honour or gift to someone

examples.text: The school bestowed an award on her for her kindness.

translations.zh: 学校因她的善良授予她一个奖项。

senses.usageNote: Use 'bestow something on/upon someone'. It is formal.

senses.definition: too ready to believe what other people tell you

examples.text: Don't be so gullible — not everything online is true.

translations.zh: 别那么容易上当——网上的东西并非都是真的。

senses.definition: unusual and typical of one particular person

examples.text: He has an idiosyncratic way of tying his shoes.

translations.zh: 他系鞋带的方式很特别。

senses.definition: to keep trying to do something although it is difficult

examples.text: If you persevere with the piano, you will improve.

translations.zh: 如果你坚持练钢琴，就会进步。

senses.usageNote: Say 'persevere with something' or 'persevere in doing something'.

senses.definition: to pay back money that someone has spent

examples.text: The school will reimburse parents for the train tickets.

translations.zh: 学校会给家长报销火车票。

senses.definition: happening sometimes, but not regularly

examples.text: There will be sporadic showers this afternoon.

translations.zh: 今天下午会有零星阵雨。

senses.definition: good for your health, or morally good

translations.zh: 有益健康的；有益身心的

examples.text: The café serves simple, wholesome food.

translations.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应简单又健康的食物。

senses.definition: a lack of something; not enough of it

examples.text: There is a dearth of parks in this part of the city.

translations.zh: 城市的这一片区缺少公园。

senses.usageNote: Always 'a dearth of something'. Formal.

senses.definition: very detailed; made of small grains

examples.text: We need more granular data to find the problem.

translations.zh: 我们需要更细致的数据来找出问题所在。

senses.definition: to describe or show something exactly

examples.text: The rules clearly delineate each player's role.

translations.zh: 规则清楚地规定了每个选手的角色。

senses.definition: a person who is not an expert in a particular subject

examples.text: The guide explains the science so that a layman can follow it.

translations.zh: 这本指南对科学知识的解释让外行也能看懂。

senses.usageNote: The phrase 'in layman's terms' means in simple language that anyone can understand.

senses.definition: the responsibility for doing something

examples.text: The onus is on each student to hand in work on time.

translations.zh: 每个学生都有责任按时交作业。

senses.usageNote: Usually 'the onus is on someone to do something'.

senses.definition: done with great care and attention to detail

translations.zh: 一丝不苟的；煞费苦心的

examples.text: Restoring the old painting was painstaking work.

translations.zh: 修复这幅古画是一项需要一丝不苟的工作。

senses.definition: confused because you cannot understand something

examples.text: The perplexed tourists stared at the map.

translations.zh: 困惑的游客们盯着地图看。

senses.definition: a natural tendency to behave in a certain way

examples.text: My cat has a propensity to sleep in the sun.

translations.zh: 我的猫喜欢在阳光下睡觉。

senses.usageNote: Usually 'a propensity for something' or 'a propensity to do something'.

senses.definition: to give up power, control or a right, often unwillingly

examples.text: She relinquished her role as team captain.

senses.definition: a short rest from something difficult or unpleasant

examples.text: The shade gave us a brief respite from the heat.

translations.zh: 树荫让我们暂时躲开了炎热。

senses.definition: very common; used about bad things

examples.text: The first draft was rife with spelling mistakes.

senses.usageNote: Used after the verb, not before a noun: 'Rumours were rife' or 'rife with mistakes'.

senses.definition: very basic and simple

examples.text: I have only a rudimentary knowledge of French.

senses.definition: to make something completely wet, or to fill it so full that no more can be added

examples.text: The market is saturated with similar phones.

translations.zh: 市场上同类手机已经饱和。

senses.definition: understood without being said directly

examples.text: There was a tacit agreement not to mention the broken vase.

translations.zh: 大家心照不宣，不提那个打破的花瓶。

senses.definition: a position that gives a good view or advantage

examples.text: From our vantage point on the hill, we could see the sea.

translations.zh: 从山上的有利位置，我们能看到大海。

senses.usageNote: Almost always used in 'vantage point'.

senses.definition: to make something clear by explaining it more fully

examples.text: The author elucidates a difficult argument.

translations.zh: 作者阐明了一个艰深的论点。

senses.definition: not directly connected with the subject; not needed

examples.text: Remove any extraneous details from your summary.

translations.zh: 删掉摘要中所有无关的细节。

senses.definition: smaller in amount than you need or want

examples.text: The students lived on a meagre budget.

translations.zh: 学生们靠微薄的预算过日子。

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'meagre'; American English uses 'meager'.

senses.definition: to prove that a statement or idea is wrong

examples.text: New evidence refuted the old theory.

senses.usageNote: Strictly, 'refute' means to prove something wrong, not just to deny it.

senses.definition: not careful or strict enough

examples.text: Security at the old gate was rather lax.

translations.zh: 旧大门的安保相当松懈。

senses.definition: not as strict as expected when punishing or judging someone

examples.text: The teacher was lenient and gave us an extra day.

translations.zh: 老师很宽容，多给了我们一天时间。

senses.definition: to suggest an idea as a basis for discussion

examples.text: The article posits that sleep helps memory.

translations.zh: 这篇文章提出，睡眠有助于记忆。

senses.definition: to increase quickly in number

examples.text: Coffee shops have proliferated in the city centre.

senses.definition: very determined and not willing to change your mind

examples.text: She remained resolute in her decision to study medicine.

senses.definition: to lead an activity or campaign

examples.text: Two pupils spearheaded the campaign to reduce plastic waste.

translations.zh: 两名学生带头发起了减少塑料垃圾的活动。

senses.definition: clearly expressed in a few words

examples.text: Please keep your answers succinct.

translations.zh: 请把你的回答写得简明扼要。

senses.definition: not giving up easily; holding on firmly

examples.text: She is a tenacious player who never stops running.

translations.zh: 她是一名顽强的球员，从不停止奔跑。

senses.definition: not necessary or not deserved

translations.zh: 不必要的；无根据的；不应有的

examples.text: Your worries about the test are unwarranted.

translations.zh: 你对考试的担心是多余的。

senses.definition: very high, or having high and noble aims

examples.text: The club has lofty goals for next season.

translations.zh: 俱乐部为下个赛季定下了远大的目标。

senses.definition: to be connected with something (formal)

examples.text: Please ask only questions that pertain to the lesson.

translations.zh: 请只提与本课有关的问题。

senses.usageNote: Always used with 'to': 'pertain to something'.

senses.definition: thinking about a past event with knowledge you did not have then

examples.text: In retrospect, we should have left earlier.

translations.zh: 回想起来，我们应该早点出发。

senses.usageNote: Almost always used in the phrase 'in retrospect'.

senses.definition: to change something to make it more modern or attractive

examples.text: The café revamped its menu for the summer.

translations.zh: 这家咖啡馆为夏季改进了菜单。

senses.definition: to take the place of something older or less modern

examples.text: Paper maps have been largely superseded by phone apps.

translations.zh: 纸质地图已在很大程度上被手机应用取代。

senses.usageNote: Often misspelt: it ends in '-sede', not '-cede'.

senses.definition: clear enough to be read easily

translations.zh: 清晰可读的；字迹清楚的

examples.text: Please make sure your handwriting is legible.

translations.zh: 请确保你的字迹清晰易读。

senses.definition: clearly expressed and easy to understand

translations.zh: 清晰易懂的；表达清楚的

examples.text: Her lucid explanation helped everyone understand the problem.

translations.zh: 她清晰的解释让大家都理解了这个问题。

senses.definition: to spread through every part of something

examples.text: The smell of coffee permeated the whole house.

translations.zh: 咖啡的香味弥漫了整个房子。

senses.definition: showing very strong feelings or opinions

examples.text: There was vehement opposition to closing the library.

translations.zh: 关闭图书馆的计划遭到强烈反对。

senses.usageNote: The 'h' is silent: /ˈviːəmənt/.

senses.definition: to prove that someone was right after others doubted them

examples.text: The final result vindicated the coach's decision.

translations.zh: 最终结果证明了教练的决定是正确的。

senses.definition: having no energy and not wanting to do anything

translations.zh: 无精打采的；昏昏欲睡的

examples.text: Hot weather makes me feel lethargic.

translations.zh: 炎热的天气让我感到无精打采。

senses.definition: to work closely with someone and share information with them

examples.text: Our team will liaise with the museum about the school trip.

translations.zh: 我们团队会就学校参观一事与博物馆联络。

senses.usageNote: Usually 'liaise with someone' or 'liaise between two groups'.

senses.definition: to take part in an activity (formal); or to eat or drink something

examples.text: All guests are invited to partake in the dancing.

translations.zh: 欢迎所有来宾一起跳舞。

senses.definition: a system for putting things, especially living things, into groups

examples.text: The book explains the taxonomy of insects.

translations.zh: 这本书介绍了昆虫的分类。

senses.definition: using exactly the same words

examples.text: Do not copy the text verbatim; use your own words.

translations.zh: 不要逐字照抄原文，要用自己的话写。

senses.definition: wanting a lot of something, especially food or books

examples.text: My sister is a voracious reader.

translations.zh: 我妹妹是个如饥似渴的读者。

senses.definition: extremely enthusiastic about something, sometimes too much

examples.text: The zealous librarian checked every returned book twice.

translations.zh: 那位热心的图书管理员把每本还回来的书都检查了两遍。

senses.usageNote: Note the vowel change: 'zeal' /ziːl/ but 'zealous' /ˈzeləs/.

senses.definition: lasting for a very short time

examples.text: Cramming produces ephemeral knowledge.

translations.zh: 临时抱佛脚产生的是转瞬即逝的知识。

senses.definition: the time when something is most successful or powerful

examples.text: The band reached its zenith in the late 1990s.

translations.zh: 这个乐队在九十年代末达到了巅峰。

senses.definition: just starting to develop

examples.text: The town's nascent tourist industry needs support.

translations.zh: 这个小镇刚刚起步的旅游业需要扶持。

senses.definition: a state of not being able to decide what to do

examples.text: I'm in a quandary about which club to join.

translations.zh: 我在加入哪个社团的问题上左右为难。

senses.definition: to put two different things next to each other so that people can compare them

examples.text: The exhibition juxtaposes old photographs with modern ones.

translations.zh: 这个展览把老照片和现代照片并列展出。

senses.definition: deserving praise, even if not fully successful

examples.text: Their aim of planting a million trees is laudable.

translations.zh: 他们种植一百万棵树的目标值得称赞。
